oliver (Design): quick touchpoint on the on-prem/VPC setup preflight. want to tighten the connectivity step copy, ARIA, and the fallback flow for strict networks. saw a user ask "do you run commands on my host?" we need very explicit language.

mai (UX): agree. suggest control label: `Run connectivity checks (recommended)` and a one-line clarifier right under it: `Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs. No credentials or commands are sent.` keeps it short but explicit.

frank (Eng): accurate. probe order: TCP handshake -> SSH probe when port 22 -> optional HTTP GET. originates from a small set of IPv4 health-checker IPs (i'll paste CIDRs). note: auto checks are IPv4-only today  flag IPv6-only environments. also we never authenticate or run remote commands.

oliver (Design): UX asks: show per-probe chips (TCP  SSH  HTTP) with icons and color states, and an inline "Troubleshoot" link that expands remediation steps. if a probe fails, show an inline pill like `SSH check failed` plus a concise remediation hint.

anya (Product): policy: default the toggle OFF for private/on-prem and ON for hosted. CTA ordering: hosted primary = "Run from Redwood", secondary = "Download local probe"; for private default primary = "Download local probe". add a short "Privacy details" link under the control.

mai (UX): accessibility: the toggle must include aria-describedby containing the full clarifier sentence. use a polite live region (role=status) to say "Connectivity checks running" then final state plus suggested next step. when a check fails, move focus to the failing chip and announce the short reason. avoid traps  let users tab back to the form.

frank (Eng): implementation notes: will return `probe_mode` (hosted|manual) and `probe_details` array (label,status,reason,logs_url). logs_url will be short-lived. local probe option will be a small script that runs same handshakes and posts results to a signed URL; it will redact local configs before upload. we will also avoid storing any credentials or secret-like strings.

oliver (Design): proposed microcopy (compact):
`Run connectivity checks (recommended)`
`Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from our health-checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials or commands are sent. If you cannot allow our IPs, download a local probe to run inside your network.`

inline error example:
`SSH check failed  could not reach bastion.internal:22. Verify outbound rules for permitted Redwood IPs or run the local probe.`

mai (UX): keyboard flow: Enter on the toggle should start the run and move focus to a status region with role=status. SR should say "Connectivity checks running" then update to "Connectivity checks passed" or "Connectivity checks failed  SSH timed out". make error "View troubleshooting" links keyboard-focusable.

anya (Product): minor copy preference: use "permitted IPs" instead of "allowlist" everywhere. and in PRD i'll call out default toggle states. frank, can you paste the CIDRs + one-paragraph privacy blurb here for the mock link?

frank (Eng): will post CIDRs + privacy blurb in this thread by EOD. logs will include target host and probe IPs; we'll scrub token-like patterns. local probe will only upload match results, timings, and short error strings.

ci-bot: FYI  staging deploy scheduled 2025-11-25T08:00Z. :rocket:

oliver (Design): thanks all. i'll mock the compact prereq banner + inline expandable probe card with chips, the toggle, and the CTA ordering per deployment. ping @mai for final ARIA text review when ready.

anya (Product): perfect  i'll update the spec and note breadcrumb status behavior (show final pass/fail on wizard breadcrumb). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
